verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows llamafile's Cosmopolitan/APE format supports 'most operating systems and CPU architectures' (llamafile-gh-3) in vague terms, but no documentation, GitHub reference, or community report specifically confirms PowerPC or other non-x86/ARM CPU support. Actual OS/hardware support pages (llamafile-docs-11, llamafile-docs-12) only detail OS and GPU vendor support, not exotic CPU architectures.
